title: malus pumila var. joannis
intro: Malus pumila var. joannis, commonly known as the Wild Apple, is a variety of apple tree native to Eastern Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to boost the immune system and protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Malus pumila var. joannis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
